name: DepositPhotos Component

title.zh: DepositPhotos · 先比较素材构图再核具体授权

description.zh: 看完整构图和原署名，再核下载授权。 以摄影图片为主要入口的库存素材库，也提供矢量、插画和PNG。已核实的Unlimited Monthly个人图片订阅为USD29/月，采用Individual Standard许可；其他套餐与媒体另行核对。
description.en: A stock-image library led by photography, also offering vectors, illustrations and PNG assets. The verified Unlimited Monthly individual image subscription is USD29 per month under the Individual Standard license; other plans and media require separate checks.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by DepositPhotos (https://depositphotos.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看完整构图和原署名，再核下载授权。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先在背景分类里比较渐变、纹理和几何图像的色调与留白，再看照片详情的完整构图。左侧方向与人物条件可帮助梳理选图需求，但本次没有测试筛选或下载。已核的个人月订阅通常可商用，Standard印刷上限为五十万份，转移、再授权和素材转售仍有限制；带水印预览不能直接交付，其他媒体和团队套餐另核。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
